name: Cassano all'Ionio (Italy)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cassano all'Ionio (a yellow unicorn on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Cassano all'Ionio, a comune in Calabria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Cassano all'Ionio arms — yellow unicorn on blue, crowned, within branches
